summary: Iteration-6 (Notifications + Account + Audit Logs + Privacy + Mobile hero) validated end-to-end. Backend: extended /app/backend/tests/backend_test.py by +18 tests (Notifications settings shape, redacted audit logging, appointment/contact resilience to bad SMTP, notification-test channel handling, Account get/update, password change wrong/weak/success + RESTORE, audit-log actions). Total 70/70 pytest pass. Frontend: verified privacy policy page (9 sections), footer links (footer-link-privacy + footer-bottom-privacy → /privacy-policy), mobile hero height (590px in 480-700 range at 390px viewport), desktop hero (828px ≈92vh at 1440x900), admin sidebar nav items (Account + Activity Log), /admin/account form auto-populates name/email from GET /admin/account/me, profile save + password change (wrong→error, correct→success, then RESTORED to Admin@123), /admin/audit-logs table renders 49 rows, /admin/settings has all 12 notification-related testids present. FIXED one testid inconsistency in AdminLayout.jsx: `data-testid={admin-nav-${label.toLowerCase()}}` produced `admin-nav-activity log` (with a space) for the 'Activity Log' item — the spec (and the test brief) require `admin-nav-activity-log` (hyphenated). Replaced with slug-safe `.replace(/\s+/g,'-')` for both desktop and mobile sidebar. Admin password confirmed still 'Admin@123' at end of run (curl 200).

issues: Recharts warning: 'The width(-1) and height(-1) of chart should be greater than 0' — non-blocking, likely chart container animating from 0 on mount; pre-existing (not caused by this iteration).

action_items: OPTIONAL: consider making `admin-nav-*` testid derivation slugify identically wherever new multi-word nav items are added in the future (fixed for now).
OPTIONAL: Recharts container 0-width warning on dashboard — set explicit `minHeight` on ResponsiveContainer or wrap in a sized div.
critical_code_review_comments: notifications.py uses stdlib `smtplib` (blocking I/O) inside `async def send_email_smtp` — the SMTP call will block the FastAPI worker's event loop for up to 15s per attempt. Because the notify code runs in a BackgroundTask this is less critical (task runs after response is sent), but under high load consider `aiosmtplib` or `run_in_threadpool(smtplib.SMTP...)`. Not blocking for MVP.
server.py POST /appointments creates the appointment first, then schedules `_notify()` as a background task. Good — appointment succeeds even if SMTP/WhatsApp are down (verified by tests).

PUT /admin/settings redaction: sensitive keys `smtp_password` and `whatsapp_access_token` are correctly redacted to '***' in the audit-log entry (verified). Consider ALSO redacting from any error-log traces if smtp exceptions include creds.
GET /admin/audit-logs returns up to 200 entries. For long-running clinics this will grow unbounded — add pagination (skip/limit) and index on created_at (currently no index on audit_logs collection).
audit_logs collection has NO index — add `db.audit_logs.create_index('created_at')` in create_indexes(); descending sort on unindexed field will slow as the collection grows.

Password strength validator (`_validate_password_strength`) does not require a special character. Compared to typical policies this is acceptable for a small clinic admin panel but flag for future hardening.

server.py account update endpoint (`PUT /admin/account/me`) allows arbitrary field passthrough via `model_dump(exclude_unset=True)` because `ProfileIn` uses `extra='ignore'`. Good — no way for a caller to inject role/password_hash. Confirmed safe.

PrivacyPolicy.jsx: content is hard-coded in JSX; `settings.privacy_policy` field is accepted by backend but the frontend page ignores it (no admin-editable render path). Consider rendering `settings.privacy_policy` in a MarkDown block when set. Non-blocking.
Admin sidebar testid derivation used `label.toLowerCase()` — fragile for any multi-word future items. FIXED to slugify.
notify_new_appointment / notify_new_contact quietly swallow individual channel failures (returns dict), which is intentional; log write to db.notification_log captures the outcome. Good design.

rca of the issue: Only issue discovered was a data-testid inconsistency in AdminLayout.jsx. Repro: sidebar rendered NavLink with `data-testid={\`admin-nav-${it.label.toLowerCase()}\`}` which produced `admin-nav-activity log` (with a space) for the label 'Activity Log', but the iteration-6 spec and Playwright selectors expected the slug-form `admin-nav-activity-log`. Root cause: naive lowercase without whitespace collapsing. Fix: replaced with `.toLowerCase().replace(/\s+/g,'-')` — a 2-character behavior change per location. Verified fix via Playwright query on both `admin-nav-account` and `admin-nav-activity-log` immediately after login — both PRESENT. Same fix applied to `admin-mobile-nav-*`. No functional or user-facing regression; testability only.
